question: En cáncer de pulmón, ¿qué 3 sponsors de la industria tienen más ensayos detenidos (terminados o retirados)? Contá solo al sponsor principal de cada ensayo.

attempts.query:
SELECT sp.name
FROM aact.sponsors sp
JOIN aact.studies s ON s.nct_id = sp.nct_id
WHERE sp.lead_or_collaborator = 'lead' AND sp.agency_class = 'INDUSTRY'
  AND s.overall_status IN ('TERMINATED','WITHDRAWN')
  AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM aact.browse_conditions b WHERE b.nct_id = s.nct_id AND b.downcase_mesh_term = 'lung neoplasms')
GROUP BY sp.name
ORDER BY count(DISTINCT s.nct_id) DESC
LIMIT 3
